audit.why: 6/10 difficulty and an even read match 50.54% over 93 games. The lane is a range stalemate: Teemo cannot be caught by a fixed 650-unit dash, Galio cannot be killed by magic poke he reduces. Both content and full already say this.
sources: scratchpad packet galio.json entry teemo (50.54%, 93 games)

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike line is written as 'trade when Blinding Dart is down' without ever stating that Blinding Dart has a flat 7-second cooldown at all five ranks. breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all sell a downtime window that barely exists.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is cooldown '7' with no per-rank list in the kit — it does not shorten and it does not lengthen. Against Justice Punch at 11s rank 1 and Shield of Durand at 18s rank 1, Teemo has a blind for every single Galio commit in the early game. Advice built on waiting out the blind is advice to never trade.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart is flat 7s at every rank; Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7; Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14; Hero's Entrance 180/160/140. Plan around the blind landing, not around its downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why states 'the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight', and dontsFull[0] tells you not to E-punch into Blinding Dart 'it catches you mid-dash'. Both treat the blind and mid-flight interrupts as answers to Justice Punch.
audit.why: Justice Punch cannot be interrupted once it is travelling — only an immobilise landing during its cast time prevents activation, and Teemo has no immobilise at all. Blind makes basic attacks miss; it does nothing to a dash or to the 0.75s knockup. The advice inverts the correct play, which is to lead with E and hold the empowered auto until the blind has been spent.
audit.corrected: Lead with Justice Punch — the dash and its 0.75s knockup land through Blinding Dart. What the blind erases is Colossal Smash and the autos inside the W window, so those come after the blind is gone.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch 'knocked up for 0.75 seconds'; dash cannot be interrupted mid-travel, immobilising effects during cast time prevent activation)
champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (Q Blinding Dart: blinds the target; no immobilise in kit)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer states that Winds of War outranges Teemo. content.early actively says the opposite: 'Don't walk up to throw a windblast at his auto range; you'll just eat a blind and a free Toxic Shot poison tick.'
audit.why: Winds of War is 825 range; Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot autos are both 680. Galio does not have to enter Teemo's range to poke — the whole 'uncatchable ranged bully' framing is wrong by 145 units. This is the single most actionable fact in the matchup and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Winds of War reaches 825 against his 680. Poke from outside Blinding Dart's range; the only reason to be inside 680 is a committed E-W.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and tldr credit 'your passive shield' with blanking his chip. content whys and wants attribute a vague 'ramping magic reduction' to Shield of Durand with no numbers.
audit.why: Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, an empowered basic attack — it is not a shield, and being a basic attack it is exactly what Blinding Dart cancels. The magic shield is Shield of Durand's own passive (7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% of maximum health, restored after 12/10/8 seconds by level without taking damage) and the active reduction is 25/30/35/40/45% versus magic against 12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5% versus physical. Naming the right source matters because the shield disappears the moment poison ticks on you, which is precisely Teemo's plan.
audit.corrected: The magic shield belongs to Shield of Durand, not the passive, and Toxic Shot's 4-second poison keeps you in combat so it never recharges in lane. The passive is Colossal Smash, a basic attack the blind erases.
sources: champ-data/_kits/galio.json (P Colossal Smash: 'Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area')
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (W passive shield 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health, restores after 12/10/8s without taking damage; active 25/30/35/40/45% magic vs 12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5% physical)

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] says Teemo kites 'on his passive stealth and base move speed'. Move Quick is never named anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Move Quick (W) is the 14-second kiting tool and it is what actually walks him out of the tornado and out of Justice Punch follow-up range. Guerrilla Warfare (P) is the stealth. Collapsing both into 'passive stealth and base move speed' hides the 14-second cooldown you can play around.
audit.corrected: Move Quick (W) on a 14s cooldown is the kite; its passive speed breaks when a champion or turret strikes him, so landing anything at all slows the disengage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (W Move Quick, cooldown 14: 'passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret')

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advice never accounts for Toxic Shot being an on-hit effect.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags 'onhit-itemization: Teemo applies on-hit through Toxic Shot (E) — their damage scales with attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong.' The kit confirms Toxic Shot is flagged onHit and applies per attack. Buying armour against Teemo does the wrong thing entirely.
audit.corrected: Toxic Shot is on-hit and scales with his attack speed, so armour is the wrong lever — health plus the Shield of Durand stance is what shrinks the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says the Justice Punch dash halts on terrain, which is the only way Galio ever lands it on Teemo.
audit.why: The dash stops when it hits terrain or a champion. Against a champion with no dash, a wall behind Teemo removes his backwards kite and turns a whiffed E into a landed knockup plus a full W taunt. content.mid gestures at 'if he mispositions against a wall' but never explains why the wall matters.
audit.corrected: Spend Justice Punch only with a wall at his back — the dash stops on terrain, Teemo has no dash to leave with, and the 0.75s knockup buys the whole W channel.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch: the dash 'stops his charge' on terrain or champions)

audit.why: 50.54% over 93 games; 'EVEN' and 6/10 are consistent with it.
The packet flags 'Hold Shield of Durand' and 'Use Winds of War' as probable wrong ability names. Both are false positives from the near-miss matcher — those are the correct names for W and Q.

edits.before: Teemo's Blinding Dart (Q) defines the early lane — it cancels your empowered Colossal Smash auto and any auto inside a Shield of Durand window, and at Level 1 you have only Winds of War and no dash to reach him. Don't walk up to throw a windblast at his auto range; you'll just eat a blind and a free Toxic Shot poison tick. Farm with the tip of Winds of War, soak the chip, and remember the upside: his poke is magic damage, which is precisely what Shield of Durand absorbs, so trades cost you far less than the health bar suggests.
edits.after: Teemo's Blinding Dart (Q) defines the early lane — it cancels your empowered Colossal Smash auto and every auto inside a Shield of Durand window, and it is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so you never wait it out. What it cannot touch is Winds of War: 825 range against his 680, so poke from outside his dart instead of walking into it. Farm with the tip of the tornado, soak the chip, and bank the upside — his poison is magic damage, and Shield of Durand cuts 25% of that at rank 1 on top of a passive magic shield worth 7.5% of your max health.

edits.before: At 3 your Q-W-E exists, but be honest: you still can't run him down — Justice Punch is a fixed-length dash and he kites the instant it lands, no shrooms even required. Use Winds of War to clear and deny his Toxic Shot zoning, and only commit Justice Punch into a Shield of Durand taunt if he mispositions against a wall with his blind on cooldown. Level 6 is the swing: you will not solo-kill a healthy Teemo, so don't force it — Hero's Entrance converts a lane stalemate into pressure elsewhere, and that global beats trading blows with a champion who just blinds you and walks off.
edits.after: At 3 your Q-W-E exists, but be honest: you still can't run him down — Justice Punch is a fixed 650-unit dash and Move Quick kites him out the instant it lands. Use Winds of War to clear and deny his Toxic Shot zoning, and spend Justice Punch only with a wall at his back, since the dash stops on terrain and the knockup then buys a full W taunt. Toxic Shot is on-hit and scales with his attack speed, so armour reads these trades wrong. Level 6 is the swing: you will not solo-kill a healthy Teemo — Hero's Entrance, 180 seconds at rank 1, converts the stalemate into pressure elsewhere.

notes: Verified from wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (used across this slice): Shield of Durand active reduces magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half that, 12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5%; its passive is a magic shield of 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health restoring after 12/10/8s (by level) out of combat; taunt lands on release with radius 175-350 and duration 0.5-1.5s scaled by channel time. Justice Punch knocks up 0.75s, cannot be interrupted mid-travel (only an immobilise during cast time stops it), is disabled outright while Grounded, and the dash halts on terrain or champions. Winds of War is 825 range, tornado lasts 2s, no slow; the windblasts are blockable individually by Wind Wall / Unbreakable, and a spell shield eats the gusts but not the tornado. Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s and is CC-immune after 1.25s, and grants allies the Shield of Durand magic shield for 5s. Colossal Smash is a 5s empowered auto (reduced 3s per ability hit on a champion), 250 radius, and scales with 60% bonus magic resist. The kit file's derived flags for Galio E list 'terrain' and omit 'knockup' — both are wrong against Riot's own description text ('knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters'); Justice Punch creates no terrain. I used the description. The packet's levelChart for teemo (Teemo,Teemo,Skill,Skill,Galio,Skill,Galio) does not match either layer on disk, which both hold Skill,Teemo,Teemo,Skill,Skill,Teemo,Teemo — and the on-disk chart already mirrors teemo__galio exactly, so I left the chart alone rather than break the mirror.
